title: A Message Appears on My Mirror Every Time I Shower…
hook: Every time I shower, the same message appears on my mirror
story: Every time I take a hot shower, the steam on my bathroom mirror shows the same message: "Check the vent." I figured the last tenant wrote it as a joke, and the grease just never wiped off. For a month, I ignored it. Then one night, the message changed. It said, "PLEASE check the vent." I scrubbed that mirror with glass cleaner until my arms hurt. Next shower, it was back. Same words. So I finally unscrewed the vent cover above the toilet. Inside was a small plastic box. In the box was a phone, still charging from a wire someone had run through the wall. The camera was pointed straight at the shower. I called the police, and they followed the wire to the apartment next door. The guy had been doing it since before I moved in. Here's the part I still can't explain. The officer took a photo of the mirror for the report. And when he zoomed in, he said whoever wrote that message… wrote it from the other side of the glass.
description:
I should have listened the first time. 🚿
